paragraphs.text: And it came to pass in the sixth week, in the seventh year thereof, [1904 A.M.] that Abram said to Terah his father, saying, 'Father!' And he said, 'Behold, here am I, my son.' And he said, 'What help and profit have we from those idols which thou dost worship, And before which thou dost bow thyself? For there is no spirit in them, For they are dumb forms, and a misleading of the heart.
paragraphs.original: ወኮነ፡ በሳድስ፡ ሰሙን፡ በሳብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ይቤሎ፡ አብራም፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ አባ፡
paragraphs.translit: wakona basādəs samun basābəʿ ʿāmat lazəntu ʾiyobēlwu yəbēlo ʾabrām latārā ʾabuhu ʾənza yəbəl ʾabā

paragraphs.text: Worship them not: Worship the God of heaven, Who causes the rain and the dew to descend on the earth And does everything upon the earth, And has created everything by His word, And all life is from before His face.
paragraphs.original: ምንተ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ወክብር፡ ቦቱ፡ እምነ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጣዖታት፡ ዘአንተ፡ ትትፈቅሩ፡ ወትሰግዱ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: mənta radāʾē wakbər botu ʾəmna kiyāhomu ṭāʿotāt zaʾanta tətfaqru watsagdu qədmēhomu

paragraphs.text: Why do ye worship things that have no spirit in them? For they are the work of (men's) hands, And on your shoulders do ye bear them, And ye have no help from them, But they are a great cause of shame to those who make them, And a misleading of the heart to those who worship them: Worship them not.'
paragraphs.original: እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቦቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ጽሙማን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወአቡሰናተ፡ ልብ፡ ወምንተኒ፡ ይክሉ፡ ገቢረ፡ ለርእስ፡ ሎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma ʾalbo manfasa botu ʾəmuntu ṣəmumān ʾəmuntu waʾabusanāta ləb waməntani yəklu gabira larʾəs lomu

paragraphs.text: And his father said unto him, I also know it, my son, but what shall I do with a people made me to serve before them? And if I tell them the truth, they will slay me; for their soul cleaves to them to worship them and honour them.
paragraphs.original: እሙንቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ስሕተት፡ ለልብክሙ፡ ኢትስግዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ አላ፡ ስግዱ፡ ለፈጣሬ፡ ኵሉ፡ ለዘ፡ ፈጠረ፡ ሰማየ፡ ወምድረ፡ ወአፍላገ፡ ወዘፈጠረ፡ ሰብአ፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəmuntu yəkawən lomu gəʿza səḥtat lalbəkmu ʾitsəgdu lomu ʾalā səgdu lafaṭārē kʷəlu laza faṭara samāya wamədra waʾaflāga wazafaṭara sabʾa waʾastaʾatata kiyāhomu lamawāʿla ḫəlināhu

paragraphs.text: Keep silent, my son, lest they slay thee.' these words he spake to his two brothers, and they were angry with him and he kept And in the fortieth jubilee, in the second week, in the seventh year thereof, [1925 A.M.] Abram took to himself a wife, and her name was Sarai, the daughter of his father, and she became his wife.
paragraphs.original: ወያአምር፡ አቡየ፡ አምላከ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘይቤሎ፡ ኢኒሁ፡ ኦ፡ ወልድየ፡ አንሰ፡ የአምር፡ ወምንተ፡ እትገበር፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ ዘይተአዘዙ፡ ሊተ፡ ለመጠን፡ አንሰ፡ ኬብር፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wayāʾamər ʾabuya ʾamlāka ḥəywat zaybēlo ʾinihu ʾo walədya ʾansa yaʾamər wamənta ʾətgabar laḥzəbya zaytaʾazazu lita lamaṭan ʾansa kēbər qədmēhomu

paragraphs.text: Haran, his brother, took to himself a wife in the third year of the third week, [1928 A.M.] and she bare him a son in the seventh year of this week, [1932 A.M.] and he called his name Lot. brother, took to himself And in the sixtieth year of the life of Abram, that is, in the fourth week, in the fourth year thereof, [1936 A.M.] Abram arose by night, and burned the house of the idols, and he burned all that was in the house and no man knew it.
paragraphs.original: ወቅንዓ፡ ጥቀ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኢትንግር፡ እምነዝ፡ ቃል፡ ለመነኒ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይቅትሉነ፡
paragraphs.translit: waqənʿā ṭəqa botu ʾitəngər ʾəmnaz qāl lamanani kama ʾiyqətluna

paragraphs.text: And they arose in the night and sought to save their gods midst of the fire. And Haran hasted to save them, but the fire flamed over him, and he was burnt in the fire, and he died in Ur of the Chaldees before Terah his father, and they buried And Terah went forth from Ur of the Chaldees, he and his sons, to go into the land of Lebanon and into the land of Canaan, and he dwelt in the land of Haran, and Abram dwelt with Terah his father in Haran two weeks of years.
paragraphs.original: ወይቤሎ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ኦ፡ አባ፡ አንሰ፡ እነግር፡ በ፪ አኀዊየ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃል፡
paragraphs.translit: waybēlo laʾabuhu ʾo ʾabā ʾansa ʾənagər ba2 ʾaḫawiya ʾəmna zəntu qāl

paragraphs.text: And in the sixth week, in the fifth year thereof, [1951 A.M.] Abram sat up throughout the night on the new moon of the seventh month to observe the stars from the evening to the morning, in order to see what would be the character of the year with regard to the rains, and he was alone as he sat and observed.
paragraphs.original: ወይቤሎ፡ ኢትንግር፡ ለሎሙ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃል፡ እስመ፡ ይሰምዑ፡ መንፈሶሙ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወያኦፍዑ፡ ኪያነ፡ ለዘ፡ ይትፀለሉ፡ ለዘ፡ ይትፈጥሩ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ለዐመፃ፡ ይኩኑ፡
paragraphs.translit: waybēlo ʾitəngər lalomu ʾəmna zəntu qāl ʾəsma yəsamʿu manfasomu kiyāya wayāʾofʿu kiyāna laza yətḍalalu laza yətfaṭru manfasa laʿamaḍā yəkunu

paragraphs.text: And a word came into his heart and he said: All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of the Lord. Why do I search (them) out? If He desires, He causes it to rain, morning and evening; And if He desires, He withholds it, And all things are in his hand.'
paragraphs.original: ወአርመመ፡ አብራም፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወኢነግሮ፡ ካዕበ፡ ካልአ፡ ቃለ፡ በእንተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጣዖታት፡ እስመ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ያሰትፍዕ፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾarmama ʾabrām ʾəmna qədma ʾabuhu waʾinagro kāʿba kālʾa qāla baʾənta kiyāhomu ṭāʿotāt ʾəsma yəfarəh yāsatfəʿ latārā ʾabuhu

paragraphs.text: And he prayed that night and said, 'My God, God Most High, Thou alone art my God, And Thee and Thy dominion have I chosen. And Thou hast created all things, And all things that are the work of thy hands.
paragraphs.original: ወበአርብዓ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ አብራም፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ሰራ፡ ወለተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wabaʾarəbʿā ʾiyobēlwu kāləʾ sabuʿ baḫāməs ʿāmat lazəntu ʾiyobēlwu naśʾa lotu ʾabrām bəʾsita səmā sarā walata ʾabuhu bəʾsita

paragraphs.text: Deliver me from the hands of evil spirits who have dominion over the thoughts of men's And let them not lead me astray from Thee, my God. And stablish Thou me and my seed for ever That we go not astray from henceforth and for evermore.'
paragraphs.original: ወአሮን፡ እኁሁ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለሰብዕ፡ ሰሙን፡ ለለ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሎጥ፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾaron ʾəḫuhu naśʾa lotu bəʾsita basādəs ʿāmat lasabəʿ samun lala lazəntu ʾiyobēlwu kāləʾ wawaladat lotu walda basābəʿ ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ wasamayo səmo loṭ

paragraphs.text: And he said, 'Shall I return unto Ur of the Chaldees who seek my face that I may return to them, am I to remain here in this place? The right path before Thee prosper it in the hands of Thy servant that he may fulfil (it) and that I may not walk in the deceitfulness of my heart, O my And he made an end of speaking and praying, and behold the word of the Lord was sent to him through me, saying: 'Get thee up from thy country, and from thy kindred and from the house of thy father unto a land which I will show thee, and I shall make thee a great and numerous nation.
paragraphs.original: ወቆመ፡ አብራም፡ በሌሊት፡ በዕለት፡ ሳድስ፡ ለሳብዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ ከመ፡ ያውዕያ፡ ቤታ፡ ለጣዖታት፡ ወአውዐየ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘያአምር፡
paragraphs.translit: waqoma ʾabrām balēlit baʿlat sādəs lasābəʿ warəḫ kama yāwəʿyā bētā laṭāʿotāt waʾawʿaya kʷəlu zawəstētā waʾalbo sabəʾ zayāʾamər

paragraphs.text: And I will bless thee And I will make thy name great, And thou shalt be blessed in the earth, And in Thee shall all families of the earth be blessed, And I will bless them that bless thee, And curse them that curse thee.
paragraphs.original: ወተንሥኡ፡ በሌሊት፡ ለማድኅኖ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ እምነ፡ ማእከለ፡ እሳት፡
paragraphs.translit: watanəśʾu balēlit lamādəḫno ʾamāləktihomu ʾəmna māʾkala ʾəsāt

paragraphs.text: And I will be a God to thee and thy son, and to thy son's son, and to all thy seed: fear henceforth and unto all generations of the earth I am thy God.' And the Lord God said: 'Open his mouth and his ears, that he may hear and speak with his mouth, with the language which has been revealed'; for it had ceased from the mouths of all the children of men from the day of overthrow (of Babel).
paragraphs.original: ወአሮን፡ ቆመ፡ ለማድኅኖ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወአቀደ፡ ቦቱ፡ እሳት፡ ወተውሕጠ፡ በውስተ፡ እሳት፡ ወሞተ፡ በዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ ቅድመ፡ ታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወቀበርዎ፡ በዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾaron qoma lamādəḫno kiyāhomu waʾaqada botu ʾəsāt watawəḥṭa bawəsta ʾəsāt wamota baʿur zakaladāwiyān qədma tārā ʾabuhu waqabarwo baʿur zakaladāwiyān

paragraphs.text: And I opened his mouth, and his ears and his lips, and I began with him in Hebrew in the tongue of the creation. And he took the books of his fathers, and these were written in Hebrew, and he transcribed them, and he began from henceforth to study them, and I made known to him that which he could not (understand), and he studied them during the six And it came to pass in the seventh year of the sixth week [1953 A.M.] that he spoke to his father and informed him, that he would leave Haran to go into the land of Canaan to see it and And Terah his father said unto him; Go in peace: May the eternal God make thy path straight.
paragraphs.original: ወወፅአ፡ ታራ፡ እምነ፡ ዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ ውእቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ለሐዊር፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ወምድረ፡ ከንዓን፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ካራን፡ ወኀደረ፡ አብራም፡ ምስለ፡ ታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ ካራን፡ ክልኤተ፡ ሰሙናተ፡ ዘዓመታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wawaḍʾa tārā ʾəmna ʿur zakaladāwiyān wəʾtu wawludu laḥawir mədra libānos wamədra kanʿān waḫadara mədra kārān waḫadara ʾabrām məsla tārā ʾabuhu kārān kəlʾēta samunāta zaʿāmatāt

paragraphs.text: And the Lord [(be) with thee, and] protect thee from all evil, And grant unto thee grace, mercy and favour before those who see thee, And may none of the children of men have power over thee to harm thee; And if thou seest a land pleasant to thy eyes to dwell in, then arise and take me to thee Lot with thee, the son of Haran thy brother as thine own son: the Lord be with thee.
paragraphs.original: ወበሳድስ፡ ሰሙን፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፰፪፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቆመ፡ አብራም፡ በሌሊት፡ ለዕለት፡ ሐዲስ፡ ለሳብዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ ለነጻሮ፡ ኮከብ፡ እምነ፡ ሰርክ፡ እስከ፡ ነግህ፡ ለመጠን፡ ይሬእ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ነገር፡ ለዓመቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዝናማት፡ ወቆመ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወይኔጽር፡
paragraphs.translit: wabasādəs samun lazəntu ʾiyobēlwu za82 basādəs ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ qoma ʾabrām balēlit laʿlat ḥadis lasābəʿ warəḫ lanaṣāro kokab ʾəmna sarək ʾəska nagəh lamaṭan yərēʾ zaykawən nagar laʿāmatu lāʿla zənāmāt waqoma bāḥtitu waynēṣər

paragraphs.text: And Nahor thy brother leave with me till thou returnest in peace, and we go with thee all The Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha of the Old Testament by R.H. Charles, Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1913 Scanned and Edited by Joshua Williams, Northwest Nazarene College
